stories.title: Loved by Homes Across Addis
stories.subtitle: Read real stories from homeowners and families who rely on Meraki Homes for stress-free living.
stories.ariaRegion: Customer testimonials. Scroll horizontally to read more experiences.
stories.s1Quote: Finding reliable cleaning in Addis used to be stressful. Meraki’s specialist arrived right on time with all supplies, and having her ID verification sent to my phone beforehand gave our family complete peace of mind.
stories.s2Quote: The companion care arranged for my mother has been an incredible blessing. Her caregiver is patient, respectful, and punctual. Meraki’s operations team even calls to check in after visits. Highly recommended!
stories.s3Quote: As a working professional, preparing healthy Ethiopian dishes every evening was exhausting. Our Meraki cook prepares fresh, delicious meals for the week right in our kitchen. Impeccable hygiene and incredible taste.
stories.s4Quote: Prompt response when our bathroom plumbing backed up on a weekend. The handyman arrived with proper tools, identified the issue immediately, and fixed it without leaving any mess behind. Transparent pricing with zero surprise charges.
stories.s5Quote: Our nanny is wonderful with our two young children. She is attentive, gentle, and trustworthy. Being able to book verified, police-cleared caregivers in Addis Ababa has completely transformed our work-life balance.

faqHome.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqHome.subtitle: Everything you need to know about booking, pricing, and our verified home services.
faqHome.a1: Submitting a request registers your interest and requirements. Our operations coordinator promptly verifies professional availability, location coverage, and schedule before contacting you to confirm all details. Your appointment is officially confirmed only once you approve the final scope.
faqHome.q2: Do I need an account to request a service?
faqHome.a2: No account creation is required! You can submit a booking request as a guest using simply your name, phone number, and address. You will receive a unique tracking reference (e.g. MRK-XXXXXXXXXXXX) to check your request status at any time.
faqHome.a3: Our website displays transparent starting estimates based on standard property sizes and service durations. For custom requests or larger homes, our team reviews the exact scope and confirms the final price upfront with you — never any hidden or unexpected surprise charges.
faqHome.q4: How are domestic specialists screened and trained?
faqHome.a4: Every Meraki professional completes a comprehensive background verification process including official Kebele ID validation, police clearance records, and past employer audits, followed by 5 days of intensive hands-on customer service and safety training.
faqHome.a5: We stand behind every service with our 24-hour Quality Guarantee. If any agreed task does not meet our high standards, simply let our support team know within 24 hours and we will send a specialist to rectify the work free of charge.
faqHome.q6: Which areas of Addis Ababa do you cover?
faqHome.a6: We actively serve households throughout Addis Ababa, including Bole, Kazanchis, Old Airport, Sarbet, Bisrate Gabriel, CMC, Summit, Ayat, Piassa, and surrounding sub-cities. Our coordinator confirms route coverage when reviewing your request.
faqHome.moreBody: Our customer care team is available 7 days a week to help.
